_doc: Recovery recipes for scripts/animation/cut-recovery.sh (engine: recovery-steps.mjs). One entry per ladder slice. Lanes edit THIS file when their code moves.

Recovery is always a FORWARD commit on top of the candidate (never a revert of history, never a force push): it undoes only what the slice added, and the diff against the candidate may touch nothing outside `allow`.
steps: replace | restore | restoreMatching (see recovery-steps.mjs). PREV is the release before the candidate (default: merge-base of the candidate and rabbit-hole/main).
verify: node --test sets run on the recovery branch itself at cut time, so a cut that breaks an import or a pinned test fails when it is cut, not when it is needed.
switch: the one-line statement of what flips, kept here so the doc and the script cannot drift.

mvp2b.title: streaming off: the author and repair calls go back to the non-streaming transport
mvp2b.switch: ask.js anthropicTransport returns to its previous (non-streaming) text; the tests that pin streaming go with it. Billing escrow, retry policy and deadlines live in other files and stay. EDIT THIS RECIPE when AN-17b names a narrower flag.
mvp2b.message: Animation forward recovery (MVP2b): the role calls use the previous non-streaming transport again; billing, retry and deadlines are untouched

mvp3.title: the five client features are no longer declared: the server refuses them, the renderer code stays
mvp3.switch: ANIMATION_CLIENT_FEATURES in packages/web/src/animation3d/capabilities.js goes back to ['curve_radius', 'action_motion']. The new browser stops declaring the five (client.js reads the constant), the server's clientFeatures() drops any declaration of them, clientProblems() refuses a draft that uses one (repairable), and readResult answers 409 client_update_required for a stored scene that needs one.
mvp3.message: Animation forward recovery (MVP3): ANIMATION_CLIENT_FEATURES back to curve_radius and action_motion, so the five SGD client features are refused for every browser; renderer and contract code stay

mvp4.title: prompts restored to the previous release's text
mvp4.switch: the planner, author, repair and review prompt files (agents/animation-author.js, agents/animation-brief.js) and the fit test that pins their size go back to PREV. If a file that is NOT restored imports something the restored prompt files no longer export (an archetype table, say), the verify step fails at cut time: add that file to the restore list.
mvp4.message: Animation forward recovery (MVP4): the planner, author, repair and review prompts are back to the previous release's text

mvp5.title: copy-line restore: loss surfaces are 'not supported yet' again and SGD leaves the claimed list
mvp5.switch: every UI, test or browser-check file the candidate changed whose PREVIOUS text carried the 'loss surfaces ... not supported yet' line goes back to PREV (the request-box copy and the claimed-capabilities line are one string in the UI). Docs are not touched. required: if no file matches, the cut stops (wrong --prev, or the copy moved).
mvp5.message: Animation forward recovery (MVP5): the request-box copy says loss surfaces and optimizers are not supported yet again, and SGD is out of the claimed capabilities
